verification_boundary: Selected council help and service cards are integrated. Police.uk publication metadata and a bounded Camden lighting sample were retrieved. Pilot boundaries and local crime totals remain unapproved. TfL direct requests return HTTP 403.

sources.name: Police.uk street-crime API
sources.finding: Monthly and approximate; persistent identifier is not a police case reference. Polygon queries are supported.
sources.implementation_action: Validate current schema, month availability, query limits and actual responses.

sources.name: Police.uk publication methodology
sources.finding: Publication anonymisation, category grouping and completeness constrain joins.
sources.implementation_action: Read known issues for each selected extract.

sources.name: Police.uk latest reporting month
sources.finding: Live metadata returned July 2026. The history route lists 36 publication months. No pilot count is calculated.
sources.implementation_action: Re-fetch at implementation; a reporting month is not an incident timestamp.

sources.name: MPS recorded crime geographic breakdown
sources.reuse_status: Inspect current dataset licence and attribution
sources.finding: Catalogue lists borough/LSOA through Aug 2026 and ward through Jul 2026; sexual offences withheld at LSOA.
sources.implementation_action: Download real files, inspect taxonomy, months, CONNECT caveat and checksums. No totals reproduced here.

sources.name: ONS crime statistics user guide
sources.finding: Police-recorded crime and victimisation measurements have different coverage and limitations.
sources.implementation_action: Document measurement and reporting processes before comparing series.

sources.name: TfL Unified API

sources.finding: Operational transport source; preserve line, stop, facility and event scope.
sources.implementation_action: Resolve real station/stop IDs and inspect current status/disruption schema.

sources.name: TfL API portal
sources.finding: Discover supported endpoints and authentication.
sources.implementation_action: Read-only integration smoke test and source-specific contract tests required.

sources.name: Hounslow Data Hub
sources.finding: Council statistics catalogue; not an independent live incident feed.
sources.implementation_action: Identify underlying primary tables, dates and derivations before reuse.

sources.name: Hounslow crime insight
sources.finding: Context dashboard discovered; full numerical extract not reproduced.
sources.implementation_action: Do not treat republished police numbers as independent corroboration.

sources.name: Hounslow Highways public reports
sources.finding: Public reporting site exists; candidate for lighting and pavement observations.
sources.implementation_action: Identify authorised read API/feed and permissible fields before automation.

sources.name: Hounslow street/traffic lights
sources.reuse_status: Link to official service; no automatic submission
sources.finding: Official handoff for infrastructure issues.
sources.implementation_action: Verify route and distinguish council/highways/private responsibilities.

sources.name: Hounslow safer communities strategy files
sources.finding: Strategy context for local partner conversations, not live warnings.
sources.implementation_action: Partner/operator and staffing agreement still required.

sources.name: Camden staying safe at night
sources.finding: Safety Bus listing retrieved with Context.dev. Published schedule is separate from deployment tonight.
sources.implementation_action: Review schedule before publication and model overnight dates correctly.

sources.name: Camden Safe Havens
sources.reuse_status: Review map/dataset terms before bulk extraction
sources.finding: Four selected council-listed venues appear as factual source-linked cards. Availability remains unconfirmed. Raw directory is not republished.
sources.implementation_action: Extract only permitted locations and verify scheme eligibility, entrance and hours.

sources.name: Camden street-lighting dataset
sources.reuse_status: Metadata declares Open Government Licence v3; attribute London Borough of Camden.
sources.finding: Live candidate-rectangle sample returned 200 assets across 36 named streets. It is not a complete pilot inventory or lamp operation feed.
sources.implementation_action: Inspect Socrata metadata, fields, licence, freshness and sample rows; probe failed in this runtime.

sources.name: Camden street-lighting location view
sources.reuse_status: Determine canonical parent dataset and licence
sources.finding: Related map/view discovered; may not be an independent dataset.
sources.implementation_action: Resolve view lineage and prevent double ingestion.

sources.name: Croydon BID Street Rangers
sources.reuse_status: No live data agreement exists for this project
sources.finding: Published street-ranger service; potential operational partner.
sources.implementation_action: Confirm coverage, staffing, authority and opt-in notice supply; not emergency dispatch.

sources.name: Croydon BID Radio Link
sources.reuse_status: Not an open intelligence feed; no scraping
sources.finding: Business/ranger/public-service coordination described; private scheme data excluded.
sources.implementation_action: Only integrate a specifically authorised public notice channel under agreement.

sources.name: Croydon lighting fault report
sources.finding: Official reporting route and contractor system; not a validated open read feed.
sources.implementation_action: Verify stable canonical interface, jurisdiction and permissible read access.

sources.name: Croydon street-lighting service
sources.finding: Service information, not a real-time map of operational lights.
sources.implementation_action: Retain distinction between asset, complaint and repair confirmation.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap lighting tag
sources.reuse_status: OSM data ODbL; attribution; wiki has separate content licence
sources.finding: Tag describes mapped lighting properties; missing tags mean missing information.
sources.implementation_action: Do not infer current illumination or safety from tag presence.

sources.name: OSMF tile usage policy
sources.finding: Public tile service forbids bulk/offline prefetch and is not a guaranteed hosting service.
sources.implementation_action: Choose compliant provider; inspect privacy/referrer/cache behaviour.

sources.name: ONS Open Geography Portal
sources.finding: Candidate canonical geography source, not a validated boundary asset in this pack.
sources.implementation_action: Choose boundary vintage, CRS, codes and downloaded checksum.

sources.name: Met StreetSafe
sources.finding: Public-place safety concerns channel, distinct from reporting a crime or emergency.
sources.implementation_action: Keep wording and destination current; no automatic submission.

sources.name: BTP text reporting
sources.finding: 61016 is non-emergency rail reporting; emergencies use 999.
sources.implementation_action: Check applicability and support SMS/manual copy without claiming submission.

sources.name: W3C PROV-O
sources.finding: Entity/activity/agent and qualified derivation concepts inform provenance design.
sources.implementation_action: Implement practical relational constraints; no claim of full RDF conformance.

sources.name: W3C SHACL
sources.finding: Reference for graph-shape validation; optional future RDF export.
sources.implementation_action: Use SQL and runtime schemas first; do not add a second graph stack now.

sources.name: SciPy Spearman correlation
sources.finding: Rank correlation API; small-sample inference requires care.
sources.implementation_action: Use dependence-aware inference, not naive significance on correlated cell-months.

sources.name: statsmodels negative-binomial family
sources.finding: Count-model reference for later exploratory analysis.
sources.implementation_action: Specify count process, dispersion, covariates and held-out validation.

sources.name: Runaway Feedback Loops in Predictive Policing
sources.reuse_status: Research citation, not content licence for scraping
sources.finding: Primary research on feedback effects in predictive-policing systems.
sources.implementation_action: Use as motivation to separate observation/exposure/enforcement from underlying prevalence.

sources.name: ICO criminal-offence data definition
sources.finding: Identifiable suspected-offender allegations can be criminal-offence data; victims/witnesses are not automatically in that category.
sources.implementation_action: Classify fields and inferences, not just source labels.

sources.name: ICO rules on criminal-offence data
sources.finding: Additional authority/UK-law conditions may be required alongside lawful basis.
sources.implementation_action: Review before processing identifiable alleged-offender data; prohibit it in MVP intake/public output.

sources.name: ICO DPIA screening
sources.finding: High-risk processing indicators include relevant location/vulnerability/systematic assessment patterns.
sources.implementation_action: Complete DPIA screening and mitigations before real pilot launch.

sources.name: Ofcom illegal-content duties
sources.finding: User-to-user service duties require assessment; hackathon label does not settle scope.
sources.implementation_action: Assess service scope, child access, reporting/complaints and moderation obligations.

sources.name: Netlify scheduled functions
sources.finding: Current docs state 30-second scheduled-function limit; schedules run on published deploys.
sources.implementation_action: Bound polling; use manual CLI/checkpoint jobs for backfills; explicitly test previews.

sources.name: Supabase PostGIS
sources.finding: PostGIS supplies geographic types and spatial queries in Postgres.
sources.implementation_action: Enable extension deliberately and test SRID/index/query semantics.

sources.name: Supabase RLS
sources.finding: RLS and grants need explicit design; views and privileged roles require care.
sources.implementation_action: Test user/moderator/partner/public permissions including graph joins and private caches.

sources.name: Codex worktrees
sources.reuse_status: Official page redirects to ChatGPT Learn worktrees documentation
sources.finding: Worktrees support independent parallel chats/checkouts in a Git repository.
sources.implementation_action: Use one branch/worktree per task, a shared contract commit and an integration owner.

sources.name: UN SDG 11
sources.finding: Target 11.7 concerns safe, inclusive, accessible public spaces.
sources.implementation_action: State alignment of intent, not measured reduction in harm.
